summary: Feed Program bulletproof safety net (Scope A) fully verified. All 8 existing tests pass and 10 new edge-case + regression tests added — all 18 pass. Covers anti-corruption guard boundaries (20/29/31% shrink), forceOverwrite persistence, tiny-farm unguarded path, history metadata shape (no blob), full blob GET, 30-snapshot pruning, and regressions for /api/farm-buddy/alerts + www→apex 301 middleware.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is 2829 lines — exceeds 700-line guideline; should be split into feature routers (feed_program, farm_buddy, photos, auth) for maintainability.
Anti-corruption guard threshold 30% is well-chosen but hard-coded; consider making it env-tunable so ops can loosen/tighten without deploy if false positives surface in production.
History pruning uses list-then-delete on every write (O(N) reads + $in delete); at scale this is fine (N≤30) but a capped collection or TTL index would be more elegant. Non-blocking observation.

restore endpoint returns edits+sheetNames in response — good for immediate rehydration — but should also stamp the restored state's history entry with 'reason: post-rewind-current' for full audit trail. Currently only the pre-rewind-backup is captured. Non-critical.

PUT/state guard is bypassed if existing state <500 bytes — correct for new-farm bootstrapping, but a malicious/buggy client could write '<500 bytes' first and then a full state, sidestepping guard on next tiny write. Real-world risk is low.
test_credentials: N/A — endpoints unauthenticated for this feature
seed_data_creation: Test farms use uuid-suffixed slugs (safety-net-XXXX, rewind-XXXX, fresh-XXXX). DEFAULT farm untouched. State-history docs left behind will be trimmed by the 30-cap and 60-day TTL.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Feed-program safety net is production-ready. Edge cases covered: 20%/29% shrink allowed, 31% blocked, force bypass, <500-byte farm unguarded, history metadata omits blob, 30-item pruning verified via 32 writes. Regressions verified: farm-buddy/alerts endpoint returns 200 with valid schema; www→apex 301 middleware confirmed via localhost curl w/ Host header spoof.
rca of the issue: N/A — feature validation, not bug RCA. Prior bug (unconditional hydration filter stripping EOB rows) has been fixed by making the filter shed-only + server-side safety net (guard + snapshot history + rewind) so any future client-side regression is caught server-side with 409 and rewind-able snapshots.
